newsitem.title: UK: Barclays up as Laing raises estimates.
newsitem.headline: Barclays up as Laing raises estimates.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc rose on Tuesday, following Monday's hefty decline, as analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing raised profit estimates and repeated a "buy" recommendation on the banking stock, dealers said.

Barclays shares were up 19-1/2p to 12.32 stg by 0817 GMT, with the rest of the bank sector also pushing ahead following Monday's profit-taking and the surprise profit-warning from National Westminster Bank Plc.
NatWest was up 3-1/2p at 758-1/2 and Lloyds TSB Plc rose 3p at 629-1/2.
Dealers said analysts at Laing had raised their current-year pre-tax profit estimate to 2,475 million stg from 2,385 million and their 1998 estimate to 2,694 million stg from 2,614 million.

Following a meeting with executives from Barclays, Laing said Barclays' BZW arm was recovering faster than some had expected and the bank was benefiting from strong loan growth and better margins, dealers said.
Analysts at Laing were not immediately available for comment.
